title: Orange Hued Kenyan Chicken Stew
description: A citrusy and flavorful Kenyan stew featuring harissa spice, this dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner, with a unique glassy-jelly texture from the orange juice and a blend of African spices. It is a macrobiotic-friendly one-pot meal.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in the pressure cooker over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the harissa spice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the orange juice and bring the mixture to a boil.
Close the pressure cooker and cook for 10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Let the pressure release naturally, then open the pressure cooker and stir in the chopped cilantro.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
